Callout.Name: Trapped in Machinery
Callout.Message: Person trapped in machinery at a depot.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, arm trapped, power off, staff with him.
Callout.Patient: I can hear you. I can hear you.

Lines.Approach: Trapped and conscious, and the fire service are cutting him out. Keep him talking.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
